# Public PrimeGaps186 baseline

`PrimeGaps186.lean`, `LICENSE`, and `README.md` in this directory are unchanged
copies from the public [openai/PrimeGaps186 repository](https://github.com/openai/PrimeGaps186).
The source file retains all upstream attribution notices. The upstream README
describes three explicit mathematical axioms; vendoring the code does not
discharge them.

The preserved README describes the complete upstream project. Its relative
links to the numerical certificate, comparator, and challenge files refer to
that project; those files are not included here. Read the
[README in its original directory](https://github.com/openai/PrimeGaps186/blob/61340d0b74163003b32756bb16e91d9209a5e330/README.md)
to follow those links.

The exact source is pinned by SHA256:

```text
fd7d9296871d276f7cd950ebf88d38627ff326abdf214a1facabc52fb6794d27  PrimeGaps186.lean
```

The Lean source matches upstream commit
[`61340d0b74163003b32756bb16e91d9209a5e330`](https://github.com/openai/PrimeGaps186/commit/61340d0b74163003b32756bb16e91d9209a5e330).
An HTTPS download of the [file at that commit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openai/PrimeGaps186/61340d0b74163003b32756bb16e91d9209a5e330/PrimeGaps186.lean)
matched both its 10,312,565-byte size and the SHA256 above.
The byte hashes, including the license and upstream README, appear in
[`../../provenance/source_manifest.json`](../../provenance/source_manifest.json).

The repository-level Lake configuration builds this module from its vendored
location with Lean `4.34.0-rc2` and Mathlib revision
`bbcd1968ee6950abe88b85dba6995da346c4b2a8`. The public comparator challenge,
which has intentional placeholders, is not part of this package.
